description: arXiv:2608.15975v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Labeling large text corpora with LLM teachers has become a practical route to training data at scale. At millions of items, hand-labeling every batch is not feasible, and two questions dominate: what label quality a teacher buys per dollar, and how to keep a fleet of GPU workers busy under skewed, failure-prone workloads.
